basics.name: Delina Sheikhrobat
basics.label: Civil Engineer | Urban Design, BIM, Sustainability & Technology-Driven Construction Innovation
basics.summary: Civil engineering graduate from the University of Tehran with a research focus on integrating Building Information Modeling (BIM) with green building and sustainability practices. Particularly interested in leveraging automation tools such as Dynamo, alongside emerging technologies like AI, to streamline design workflows and drive technology-led innovation in construction management. Combines hands-on BIM teaching experience, VR-based research work, and active leadership in academic and cultural student initiatives.

education.summary: Undergraduate studies in civil engineering with a growing specialization in Building Information Modeling (BIM), sustainable design, and the application of digital tools to construction management workflows.

publications.name: Evolution of BIM-LEED Integration: A Systematic Literature Review of Their Relationship, Applications, and Technology-Driven Changes Across LEED Versions
publications.summary: A systematic literature review tracing how Building Information Modeling (BIM) and the LEED green building certification framework have become increasingly integrated over time, examining how successive LEED versions have driven and responded to technology-led changes in sustainable design and construction practice.

work.name: University of Tehran
work.position: Teaching Assistant — Building Information Modeling (Instructor: Dr. S. Vahid Faghihi)
work.summary: Supported undergraduate instruction in a core BIM course spanning the 3D, 4D, and 5D dimensions of Building Information Modeling.
highlights: Mentored undergraduate students through core BIM workflows across the 3D (modeling), 4D (scheduling and animation), and 5D (cost estimation) dimensions of BIM.
Supported students in Autodesk Revit for parametric 3D modeling and in Autodesk Navisworks for model coordination, clash detection, and 4D construction sequencing and animation.
Guided students in Microsoft Project to develop construction schedules and link them to BIM models for 4D/5D workflows, including quantity take-off and cost estimation.

work.name: VR & Computer Graphics Lab, Department of Civil Engineering, University of Tehran
work.summary: Developed immersive VR simulations to study road-user behavior for transportation research.
highlights: Designed and developed immersive virtual-reality environments in Unity to support transportation research studies, translating real-world road and traffic scenarios into interactive 3D simulations.
Integrated VR environments with head-mounted displays to run controlled experiments examining participant (student) behavior and decision-making in simulated traffic scenarios.
Collaborated with faculty researchers to define experimental scenarios and iterate on environment design based on pilot testing feedback.

volunteer.organization: Civil Engineering Scientific Student Association, University of Tehran
volunteer.summary: Contributed to the leadership and organization of academic and extracurricular initiatives for civil engineering students at the University of Tehran.

volunteer.organization: Chamroosh — Scientific & Cultural Journal of the Civil Engineering Student Association
volunteer.summary: Founded and led the editorial direction of the association's scientific and cultural journal, overseeing content strategy, writing, and publication.
Co-organized the TEDxKish event, contributing to event planning and execution.
Served as curator and led the media team for TEDxUT across two events (May 2025 and October 2024), overseeing content curation and media production.
Served as event photographer for TEDxSUT.

languages.fluency: C1 — TOEFL iBT 110/120 (Reading: B2, Listening: C2, Writing: C1, Speaking: C1)
